description: Defines classes and mechanisms for handling signals, including signal handling, fatal signal handling, and stack trace printing in the c10 namespace.

classes.name: SignalHandler
classes.description: Handles signals like SIGINT and SIGHUP, allowing configuration of actions upon signal receipt.

classes.name: FatalSignalHandler
classes.description: Manages fatal signal handling, including printing stack traces and installing/uninstalling signal handlers.

methods.name: SignalHandler::CheckForSignals
methods.description: Checks if any configured signals have been received.

methods.name: SignalHandler::GotSIGINT
methods.description: Returns true if SIGINT was received.

methods.name: SignalHandler::GotSIGHUP
methods.description: Returns true if SIGHUP was received.

methods.name: FatalSignalHandler::setPrintStackTracesOnFatalSignal
methods.description: Enables or disables printing stack traces on fatal signals.

methods.name: FatalSignalHandler::printStackTracesOnFatalSignal
methods.description: Checks if printing stack traces on fatal signals is enabled.

methods.name: FatalSignalHandler::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FatalSignalHandler.
